charges.label: Weight component (₹6.00 per kg of billed weight)
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component (₹2.00 per km of booked lane distance)
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium (20% of freight charge = weight + distance components)
charges.quote: carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components)

document_rules.rule: Each invoice line's c-note number must correspond to a Customer booking; lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects.
A credit note must cover the full corrected amount.
Carrier invoices as trips are pooled (typically fortnightly); payment is due 21 days from invoice date.

notes: Freight = 6.00*billed_weight_kg + 2.00*distance_km, no minimum, no distance or weight tiers. Cold chain adds 20% of (weight + distance). Only standard service is offered (§2); the contract states no express rate. No charges for fragile or residential handling are listed, and the contract does not say unlisted charges are not payable, so closed_list is false. No invoice-level discounts. No dispute window stated.
